execution_requirements: Coordinator must issue exact leases and a shared-ledger suballocation before any call.
Pin the final retrieval implementation before production; a changed helper hash invalidates logical bundle requests.
Preserve exact request and raw response bytes and their hashes; reject duplicate,missing,or unexpected response indices and dimensional mismatches.
Record actual producer job ID,request/response/settings hashes,ordered input hashes,and per-decision response-index mapping in a completed producer manifest.
Attach completed manifest hash and index mapping to each bundle usage; verify the selected vectors reproduce the recorded response slice.
Charge actual tokens/cost once per producer job/response,not once per derived decision bundle.
Unknown call outcome blocks retries; follow the coordinator deadline and shared accounting policy.
limitations: This is a prepared input manifest,not a call lease,provider receipt,or embedding-quality result.
Source and query strings stay in the local staged request files; only hashes and mappings are published.
28 ordered decisions represent14 semantic judgments over3 development source groups.
UTF8 byte counts are conservative input-text size bounds,not provider token measurements;cost is not measured.
New permitted-span chunk boundaries change logical inputs. Historical vectors/bundles are not relabeled.
Execution requires a fresh coordinator lease; prior production lease is consumed.
